requirements.statement: For each non-temporal media (content shown through a plugin or the svg and canvas elements) that conveys information through colour, that information is not given by colour alone.

citations.quote: l’information ne doit pas être donnée uniquement par la couleur
Retrouver dans le document les informations données par la couleur dans un média non temporel
Contenu qui ne se déroule pas dans le temps, consultable via un plugin (Flash, Java, Silverlight…) ou via les éléments svg et canvas

routes.statement: The same information is also given by a visible text.

The same information is also given by a graphic means (pictogram, background image, shape, different border style) together with a complement in the code (aria-label, title, hidden text, aria-current).

citations.quote: Un moyen faisant intervenir du graphisme (pictogramme, image de fond, forme, style de bordure différent, etc.) et par le biais d’un complément au niveau du code (aria-label, title, texte masqué, aria-current, etc.)

routes.statement: The same information is also given by another typographic style (bold, italic, text size, another font) together with a complement in the code.

citations.quote: Un autre style typographique (gras, italique, taille de texte, autre police, etc) et par le biais d’un complément au niveau du code

routes.statement: Another means, of the kinds the methodology lists (a title attribute, an icon, a graphic effect of shape or position, a typographic effect), actually lets users who do not see, or who perceive colours or their combinations poorly, get the same information; a title attribute or an icon on its own does not meet this.

citations.quote: vérifier qu’il existe un autre moyen de récupérer cette information (présence d’un attribut title, d’une icône ou d’un effet graphique de forme ou de position, un effet typographique…)
Les moyens de transmettre une information autrement que par la couleur peuvent être
accompagnée d’une autre méthode à destination des utilisateurs qui ne voient pas ou perçoivent mal les couleurs ou leurs associations

rationale.text: The test applies to each non-temporal media that conveys information, where that information is given by colour: an interactive map whose regions are coloured by category, a chart drawn in svg or canvas. Code can find svg, canvas and plugin elements, but whether their colours carry information, and whether a legend, a pattern or a text gives it another way, is judgment. A canvas exposes only pixels, and an svg's fill values say nothing of their meaning. Each route is judgment too: whether a text, a pictogram, a shape, a style or a code complement gives the same information as the colour depends on what both mean. The requirement has one set of routes, taken from the glossary and the methodology: a visible text, a graphic means with a code complement, a typographic style with a code complement, or another means of the kinds the methodology lists (a title attribute, an icon, a shape or position effect, a typographic effect). Every route is bound by the glossary's functional requirement: the other method is there for users who do not see, or who perceive colours or their combinations poorly, and the methodology asks for another means to get the information. A means counts only if those users can actually use it. The methodology's examples are read with that requirement, not as sufficient by their mere presence. Each of the glossary's own means pairs a signal perceivable without colour (a visible text, a graphic, a typographic style) with a complement in the code. So a title attribute alone, which shows nothing until a mouse hovers over it, or an icon alone, with nothing in the code for users who do not see it, does not meet the route. The last route stays open, because the glossary says the means "peuvent être" these and the methodology's list ends in an ellipsis, and a missed route would make a correct page look failed. Whether a given means is actually usable is judgment. The two sources also give different statuses, and the entry keeps both explicit. When the information given by colour is accompanied by another usable method, the glossary says the criterion is considered not applicable, and the methodology says the test is validated. The routes model the methodology's validated outcome. On such a page the expected status is not applicable under the glossary and passed under the methodology; a future check must not choose between them silently, and the choice needs a ruling. At none the difference changes nothing. No axe rule is tagged for this test, and no custom check is registered: a fault would need a media that surely conveys information by colour, which code cannot establish. The candidate is none, with no link. Applicability is judgment: a page with no svg, canvas or plugin element holds no non-temporal media, but a page with one may or may not hold one that conveys information by colour, and an svg used as an icon is still an svg element; the entry does not claim structural applicability on that partial certainty. Needs is state: the glossary's examples are interactive (a map, an application, a slideshow), and their information by colour may appear only after the user acts on them.

citations.quote: Pour chaque média non temporel véhiculant une information
une carte interactive en Flash, une application Flash ou Java, un diaporama sont des médias non temporels

Lorsqu’une information donnée par la couleur est accompagnée d’une autre méthode à destination des utilisateurs qui ne voient pas ou perçoivent mal les couleurs ou leurs associations, le critère sera considéré comme non applicable.
Si c’est le cas pour chaque information, **le test est validé**.
